ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch occupying the central-lower quadrant of the right lobe; sparse, small white punctate spots on the predominantly black left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with high pixel-amplitude (approx. 5-15 pixels) along the right lobe trailing edge; left lobe displays more irregular topography due to attached epibionts.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the lateral margins with a sharp posterior-lateral sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: White circular and semi-circular marks clustered near the trailing edges, particularly on the right lobe, consistent with past barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, dark, near-vertical linear disruptions visible across the white central patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of attached barnacles (Coronula spp.) present on the tips and trailing edges of both lobes.
